facilityType.title: Facility type
facilityType.description: Which kind of Medicare-certified facility to look up. Nursing homes carry the fullest ratings (overall, health inspection, staffing, quality).

facilityName.title: Facility name contains
facilityName.description: Filter to facilities whose name contains this text. Partial, case-insensitive. Leave empty to sweep by state.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter state code ("CA", "TX"). Use alone to pull a whole state, or with a name/city.

city.title: City
city.description: Filter to one city (exact, case-insensitive). Optional.

minRating.title: Minimum overall rating
minRating.description: Only facilities with at least this overall star rating (1 to 5). Leave as Any for all.
